author: Quotanaut contributors
description: Live Codex account switching and automatic quota rotation for Linux.
name: quotanaut

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/index.ts --target bun --outdir dist && cp bin/launcher.cjs dist/launcher.cjs && chmod 755 dist/index.js dist/launcher.cjs
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun x biome check . && bun test
